mapper.select: SELECT E.EVENT_ID AS eventId, E.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName, E.EVENT_TITLE AS eventTitle, E.MAX_PARTICIPANTS AS maxParticipants, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_EVENT_PARTICIPANT P WHERE P.EVENT_ID = E.EVENT_ID) AS currentParticipants, ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_EVENT_PARTICIPANT P WHERE P.EVENT_ID = E.EVENT_ID) / E.MAX_PARTICIPANTS * 100, 2) AS participationRate, 0 AS participated FROM CL_EVENT E WHERE E.EVENT_ID = 1

SELECT E.EVENT_ID AS eventId, E.COMPANY_NAME AS companyName, E.EVENT_TITLE AS eventTitle, E.MAX_PARTICIPANTS AS maxParticipants, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_EVENT_PARTICIPANT P WHERE P.EVENT_ID = E.EVENT_ID) AS currentParticipants, ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_EVENT_PARTICIPANT P WHERE P.EVENT_ID = E.EVENT_ID) / E.MAX_PARTICIPANTS * 100, 2) AS participationRate, 0 AS participated FROM CL_EVENT E WHERE E.EVENT_ID = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CL_EVENT_PARTICIPANT ( PARTICIPANT_ID, EVENT_ID, MEMBER_NO, PARTICIPATED_AT ) VALUES ( CL_EVENT_PARTICIPANT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{eventId}, #{memberNo}, SYSDATE )
